name: Task Search Custom Restriction
description: Task search restriction provides administrators with flexible control over advanced search features in the Odoo Project Task module. The access right can be assigned to individual users to determine whether advanced search options are available. When Task Advanced Search is set to No, the assigned user cannot create custom filters or custom grouping in Project Task views. When the access right is enabled, users can create custom filters, apply domains, and use grouping options according to their requirements. This approach helps administrators control advanced search capabilities while keeping standard Project Task access rights and workflows unchanged.
summary: Task search restriction provides a simple and effective way to control advanced search capabilities in the Odoo Project Task module. It allows administrators to assign the Task Advanced Search access right to individual users based on their responsibilities. Users without the assigned permission cannot access advanced search options such as custom filters, custom domains, and custom grouping. Authorized users can use these advanced search features to efficiently find, filter, and organize project task records. The module helps maintain a controlled and user-friendly Project Task interface by limiting unnecessary search functionality. It works independently of standard Project Task access rights and does not modify existing Odoo security permissions. This solution is useful for organizations that require user-specific control over project task search and grouping features. Task Search Restriction improves data management, access control, and search flexibility within the Odoo Project Task module.
